name: Alpengasthof Lüsens
beschreibung: The Alpengasthof Lüsens is located at the far end of the Sellrain Valley at an altitude of approximately 1,630 metres. Situated at the terminus of the public access road, the accommodation serves as a starting point for tours in the Stubai Alps Nature Park. The inn functions as an alpine base featuring a restaurant that serves regional Tyrolean cuisine. The rooms are practically furnished in a traditional alpine style. In summer, guests make use of the inn for mountain hikes, and in winter for backcountry ski tours in open terrain. The seclusion of the location is one of its most defining characteristics. The inn is managed by the Raich family, now in their third generation.
